recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the applied clarification without making canonical resolution mandatory; future work should only revisit this area if FHIR-I decides to define canonical chaining semantics normatively rather than as optional server behavior.
issue_request: FHIR-45252 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-I R6 change request to clarify that chaining, includes, reverse includes, and the [type] modifier are not defined for reference search parameters that target elements without explicit Reference values, while servers may choose to support such behavior. It also requested canonical chaining/include examples, canonical resolution guidance, CapabilityStatement include/revInclude advertisement guidance, and a duplicated heading fix.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by commit 50ef95a57642a2038880bbf9f7433c803efc3a1e, merged via HL7/fhir#3967, which changed source/search.html. That application added some canonical include and chaining/type clarification but left stale contradictory text in the active Search narrative, did not split the resource/canonical identifier heading, omitted the canonical include section from the local TOC, and did not add the requested canonical chaining example/notes completely.
additional_context: The linked Zulip thread confirms the intended distinction: canonical chaining/include support should be optional and implementation-specific, not prohibited. FHIR-I minutes from 2024-04-15 approved FHIR-45252 as Persuasive and explicitly said the change was new optional support with no new SHALLs. FHIR-43073 is background because it introduced/reviewed the reference-search wording that prompted the later FHIR-45252 refinement.
reconciliation: Published a source-changing commit on the combined branch. The commit updates source/search.html to replace stale 'not supported/cannot' guidance with 'not defined' plus server discretion, update the [type] modifier paragraph, split Resource Identifiers from Canonical Identifiers with distinct anchors, add the Canonical References include section to the TOC, and add the canonical chaining notes and QuestionnaireResponse-to-Questionnaire example.
source_changes: source/search.html: replaced stale prohibitive reference-search language for :identifier, chaining, includes, and reverse includes with non-prohibitive 'not defined' guidance plus server discretion.
source/search.html: updated the [type] modifier explanation to allow server restrictions based on instance contents, including local/reference/type/canonical considerations.
source/search.html: split the Resource Identifiers and Canonical Identifiers headings/anchors and updated the local table of contents.
source/search.html: added the Canonical References include section to the local table of contents.
source/search.html: added canonical chaining notes and a QuestionnaireResponse.questionnaire-to-Questionnaire.status example, and converted existing chaining notes to bullets.
